title: Three Boys in Winter Coats, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Jim Teddy and Little Dickie VELOX 3
description: A charming vintage snapshot photo depicting three young boys standing side-by-side in a snowy yard in front of a bungalow home, dressed warmly in heavy double-breasted winter coats and holding caps. The picture captures a classic moment of mid-20th-century American childhood during wintertime. Handwritten text at the top front reads 'Junior, Teddie & Dickie', while pencil writing on the reverse identifies them as 'Jim Teddy and Little Dickie'.
